name: csv-contract-preflight-mcp
description: Buyer-owned MCP: explicit contract presets, agent-assisted drafting, separate report summaries and bounded native validation.

apify_token.title: Your Apify token
apify_token.description: Your own eligible buyer account token. Required for purchases; leave empty to inspect free tool metadata. Stored by your MCP client.

tools.name: start_validation
tools.description: Purchase one bounded CSV contract report using the buyer account.

tools.name: get_validation
tools.description: Retrieve the original saved run and its verified report.

tools.name: prepare_contract_draft
tools.description: Prepare instructions for the buyer agent model; no server generation.

tools.name: review_contract_draft
tools.description: Validate and preserve a proposal pending review.

tools.name: accept_contract_draft
tools.description: Explicitly accept the exact reviewed digest.

tools.name: start_validation_from_draft
tools.description: Separately authorize a paid native validation using an accepted draft.

tools.name: list_contract_templates
tools.description: List three free deterministic supported-profile contract presets.

tools.name: get_contract_template
tools.description: Inspect exact preset rules, canonical contract, limitations and synthetic examples.

tools.name: get_validation_summary
tools.description: Summarize an existing verified report without another purchase or changing the canonical report.
